## What's new in 1.9.2
- **The background blur now fades in.** When you tap the Windows key, your desktop fades smoothly into the blurred, darkened background while the windows glide into place, and it fades back when the overview closes. Before, the blur appeared all at once.
- The sharp starting picture matches how Windows shows your wallpaper (Fill, Fit, Stretch or Center), so the start of the fade lines up with your real desktop.
- The fade follows the animation speed in Settings, and is instant when animations are off.

## Download
- **`Overview-Setup.exe`**: the installer. Choose *Start with Windows*, *Check for updates automatically* and *Desktop shortcut*. Installs for your user only, no admin needed. If you already have Overview installed with updates on, it will offer this version by itself.
- **`Overview-standalone.exe`**: the same app without installing. Run it from anywhere. It never checks for updates.

Windows SmartScreen may warn because the exe isn't code-signed yet: click **More info → Run anyway**.
